summary: OMA filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Mancera, S.C. (EY), a member of Ernst & Young Global Limited, as its external auditor for fiscal year 2026, replacing Galaz, Yamazaki, Ruiz Urquiza, S.C. (Deloitte). The change, effective for FY2026, is described as part of efforts to promote continuous improvement and strengthen audit processes in line with corporate governance best practices. The board and audit committee acknowledged Deloitte's prior service. No transaction, securities offering, shareholder vote, or special-situation event is involved; this is a routine auditor rotation disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
